arithmetic.rule: Each float of template_rows.*.*.statistics (and its copy visibility_readout_corrected) is float(Fraction) of an exact rational of the integer shot counts and integer-ratio readout rates, and each of its errors is the correctly rounded square root of the exact-rational evaluation of the central-difference delta approximation of the variance; contraction_per_cz_implied is the correctly rounded cz-th root of the stored corrected visibility; pooled and chi-square sums multiply where the predecessor called pow. Every other float (bin, selector and batch contrasts, calibration, drift covariate, decision numbers) comes from IEEE basic operations, math.sqrt, math.hypot, CPython's float sum and numpy sums of at most 32 values, the 32-value ones over integer shot counts. No decimal rounding applies, and no BLAS, LAPACK, einsum or libm pow call enters a float.
